U.S. equity futures pointed to a stable open, with Nasdaq futures rising 0.29%, S&P 500 futures gaining 0.24%, and Dow futures adding 0.20%.
In commodities, crude oil eased toward $101 per barrel, while spot gold advanced toward $4,400 per ounce.
